title: Hearty Croatian Lamb Dumplings
description: Tangy and pillowy Croatian dish featuring lamb and instant yeast, simmered in a nimono-style broth for a comforting meal
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the ground lamb, onion, carrot, celery, salt, and black pepper, and mix until just combined.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, instant yeast, and egg, and add this mixture to the lamb mixture, mixing until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 12 equal pieces, and shape each piece into a ball.
In a large pot, combine the chicken broth, white wine vinegar, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to a simmer, and add the dumplings to the pot, cooking for 20 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
Serve the dumplings hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
Let the dumplings cool, then refrigerate or freeze for up to 3 days.
Reheat the dumplings in the simmering broth before serving.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
